email.subject: AI for Bochner PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

Your recognition as Legal 500 New York City Elite for Intellectual Property in 2026 reflects the caliber of work Bochner PLLC delivers across IP, corporate law, and litigation. That level of sophistication demands tools that match it.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of boutique practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding into New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
